title: Volvo FM / FH Custom Built High Tensile Aluminium Wild Bar FUPS Compliant Bullbar #47
description: Series 5 FM FH Volvo FUPS Bullbar for Wild Bar style suitable for radar attachments. 75mm hi-tensile 6mm wall tube with heavy duty uprights, contoured to compliment the new cab shape. Hi-tensile aluminium backing plate, same tensile strength as steel. LED indicator/park lights recessed in uprights.
